title: Curiosity
intro: A few open questions about what you learned and what you wonder. No right answers.

prompts.text: What is something you learned today, even a small detail?
What is a question you would like to look into when you have time?
Which tool or idea have you been meaning to try?
What is something that works well, that you wonder about?
If you had an extra hour this week to explore anything, what would it be?
What is a word or term you came across lately and would like to understand better?
What would you like to be a little more curious about?
